tools.name: news-intelligence_original-source-trace
tools.description: Cluster similar articles and identify the earliest published item. Later reprints are not treated as independent confirmation. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/news-intelligence/original-source-trace. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: news-intelligence_syndication-cluster
tools.description: Group near-duplicate titles and bodies into syndication clusters without counting repeats as confirmation. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/news-intelligence/syndication-cluster. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: news-intelligence_claim-extract
tools.description: Extract claim-like sentences and quotes from supplied article text using local heuristics. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/news-intelligence/claim-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: news-intelligence_claim-source-match
tools.description: Match supplied or extracted claims to articles by text overlap. Multiple outlets repeating a claim are not independent confirmation. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/news-intelligence/claim-source-match. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: news-intelligence_event-timeline-build
tools.description: Order supplied events or dated articles into a timeline without inventing missing dates. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/news-intelligence/event-timeline-build. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: news-intelligence_correction-history-detect
tools.description: Flag correction, update, and retraction wording or updatedAt changes in supplied articles. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/news-intelligence/correction-history-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: news-intelligence_source-independence-analyze
tools.description: Count distinct outlets and mark syndicated/similar copies as non-independent. Repeats are never claimed as confirmation. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/news-intelligence/source-independence-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: news-intelligence_contradiction-detect
tools.description: Find affirming vs negating overlapping claims, and label near-duplicate repeats without treating them as confirmation. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/news-intelligence/contradiction-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: news-intelligence_country-event-monitor
tools.description: Filter supplied articles and events by country into a dated monitor list. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/news-intelligence/country-event-monitor. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: news-intelligence_verification-evidence-report
tools.description: Aggregate source tracing, syndication, claims, contradictions, corrections, and independence findings. Repeats are never independent confirmation. Price $0.08 USDC. POST /api/v1/news-intelligence/verification-evidence-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "news-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: news-intelligence_country-event-monitor · Public sink: news-intelligence_original-source-trace, news-intelligence_syndication-cluster, news-intelligence_claim-extract, news-intelligence_claim-source-match, news-intelligence_event-timeline-build, news-intelligence_correction-history-detect, news-intelligence_source-independence-analyze, news-intelligence_contradiction-detect, news-intelligence_country-event-monitor, news-intelligence_verification-evidence-report · Destructive: news-intelligence_original-source-trace, news-intelligence_syndication-cluster, news-intelligence_claim-extract, news-intelligence_claim-source-match, news-intelligence_event-timeline-build, news-intelligence_correction-history-detect, news-intelligence_source-independence-analyze, news-intelligence_contradiction-detect, news-intelligence_country-event-monitor, news-intelligence_verification-evidence-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
